component: A stand of tall trees comes into view overhead, further dimming the light and making it increasingly difficult to find a foothold up through the pothole. Caution is absolutely necessary to prevent a case of vertigo from settling in and overwhelming the senses.
You also see a thin silverwood branch stripped of its leaves dangling out over the chasm and a craggy niche.
